_comment: Per-phase model routing. The registry resolves these tiers; the judgement about what each phase is worth lives here. See model-registry/references/routing-schema.md.

phases.why: Enumerates skill directories, reads frontmatter, and reads session logs for attribution. Fully specified file and log traversal with no judgement about the skills themselves.
Each worker reads one skill, verifies the references it can see, and scores five fixed axes against a supplied brief. Bounded input, no cross-skill reasoning.

adjust.why: A wide inventory means each worker's slice is one small skill against a fully specified brief.
Re-auditing against an open Critical/High backlog means judging whether a claimed fix holds, which is harder than a first read.

phases.why: Cross-skill overlap and coverage-gap detection over the whole inventory, plus lifecycle dispositions and a diff against the previous report. This is the pass the per-skill workers cannot do, and a wrong answer retires a skill that should have been kept.
Renders decided findings into the report contract. The judgement was made in Phase 2; this is faithful transcription against a fixed structure.
